endings.label: Suffocating Isolation
endings.description: Your world becomes a lone island, cut off from the shared narratives of existence. As the last echo of human connection fades, you drift into a void, lost to yourself and reality.

endings.label: Anguish Unending
endings.description: An icy dread seeps into your being, gnawing at your sanity. The walls of your identity crumble, replaced by an all-encompassing terror. Alone in the heart of the abyss, your reality unravels.

endings.label: Nihilistic Delirium
endings.description: Reason and sense desert you as you plunge into a carnival of the irrational. Your desperate attempts to comprehend your existence only deepen your despair. Laughter echoes in the void, mocking your faded reality.

endings.label: Lost in Oblivion
endings.description: Your past becomes a foggy labyrinth, your identity, a haunting echo. Trapped in a reality built from false symbols and shallow victories, your essence flickers and dims, swallowed by forgetfulness.

endings.label: Ouroboros Despair
endings.description: Obsessions twirl around your existence, pulling you into a gyre of despair. Inescapable fixations consume your reality, spiralling into a black hole where all light and hope are devoured.

endings.label: Baptism of Desolation
endings.description: You're lost in a sea of endless possibilities, each wave dragging you further into the murky depths of indecision. Your ability to navigate reality erodes, leaving you adrift in a suffocating, formless dread.

endings.label: Locking Vise of Paranoia
endings.description: You're ensnared in a trap of foreign concepts that clash with your true self. Rigid ideologies form invisible chains, squeezing the life from your reality. Freedom becomes an illusion, fading into a dull gray existence.

endings.label: Ego's Prison
endings.description: Your identity hardens into an unbreakable shell, trapping you within a narrow definition of self. Fear of change keeps you locked in stagnation, eroding your reality to a shallow reflection in the mirror of ego.

endings.label: Empathy's Labyrinth
endings.description: Your ability to understand others slowly crumbles, leaving you wandering in a maze of your own perspective. Your reality contracts, each day bringing greater isolation, until you're a stranger to yourself and the world.
